  "pros": [
    "Comprehensive project and task management features.",
    "Highly customizable workflows and reporting capabilities.",
    "Scalability to manage multiple large-scale banking projects."
  ],
  "cons": [
    "Initial setup and complex configuration can be challenging.",
    "Can become expensive at an enterprise scale with many users.",
    "Performance may occasionally lag with very large datasets or many concurrent users."
  ],
  "overall_experience": "The Head of PM found Wrike to be a powerful and flexible tool capable of handling the complexities of project management within a large banking institution. Its robust feature set and customization options were particularly beneficial for diverse project needs and reporting requirements. However, the initial learning curve and ongoing administrative overhead for such a large deployment were notable challenges, alongside the significant cost at scale."
